remarks: Fall into Harbor Point's latest offering w/rarely found private greenspace & covered parking, ready for occupancy! Stunningly renovated (like new construction!) 3 Bedroom, 2 full bath home w/almost 1700sf all on 1 level just 3-5 blocks to restaurants, waterfront boardwalk, Stamford Train & I-95. Outstanding features include: separate office, separate laundry/mudroom, central air, gas heat, gas cooking & backyard access. Step inside to modern, open, airy, light-filled spaces w/beautiful hardwood floors & large windows - excellent natural light. Expansive living room is an impressive area for all to gather. Sparkling eat-in kitchen shines w/stone counters & stainless steel appliances. Spacious bathrooms w/windows. Outside, relish the amazing greenspace for play. Carport & additional parking, too. Along the Gold Coast of Fairfield County, Harbor Point is one of the nation's largest luxury urban redevelopments. Whether taking a stroll around the corner at Commons Park, going for a run along the waterfront boardwalk, enjoying dinner at Fortina, taking in the views of LI Sound & Manhattan in the distance or setting sail from the marina, this incredible community is an extension of your backyard. Easy walk to downtown Stamford restaurants, entertainment & shopping, too or hop on the free Harbor Point Trolley! Everything else you could want or need is just 1-3 miles away! Also only 35 miles to Manhattan. Welcome to vibrant, walkable waterfront living & easy commuting in Connecticut!
